title: Reception of an RRCReconfigurationCompleteSidelink by the UE

entities.name: RRCReconfigurationCompleteSidelink
entities.description: Message received by the UE indicating completion of sidelink reconfiguration procedure.

entities.name: Timer T400
entities.description: Timer associated with a specific destination in sidelink communication.

entities.name: RRCReconfigurationSidelink
entities.description: Message containing sidelink reconfiguration parameters sent to the UE.

entities.name: Configurations Applied
entities.description: UE considers the configurations from RRCReconfigurationSidelink message to be successfully applied.

relations.description: Reception of RRCReconfigurationCompleteSidelink stops timer T400 for the destination if running.
Reception of RRCReconfigurationCompleteSidelink establishes that configurations from RRCReconfigurationSidelink are applied.
Configurations applied property refers to parameters from the RRCReconfigurationSidelink message.
